must: mobile-first, dark restaurant identity (ink-900 bg, fire-500 accent, cream text)
custom Tailwind design system in src/index.css — reuse .btn/.card/.chip tokens, no shadcn
avoid: decorative gradient orbs, abstract SVG blobs, glassmorphism
huge marketing headlines beyond hero, excessive cards
installing 21st shadcn components that fight the custom system

decisions.choice: Keep bespoke design system; add tasteful motion/detailing (spotlight cards, count-ups, scroll progress, cart bump) grounded in project tokens instead of importing 21st hero templates.
